## [Legal Counsel](https://builtin.com/job/legal-counsel/12097152)

5 Days AgoSaved


In-Office

Bogotá, Bogotá, D.C., COL

Software • Automation

Provide business-oriented legal support across commercial contracts, corporate matters, privacy, data protection, intellectual property, and technology transactions. Draft and negotiate agreements in Spanish and English, support customer and partner contracts, manage standard legal matters, coordinate IP portfolios, assist with security questionnaires, and maintain corporate records across international regions. The role requires in-house technology-company experience, strong contract negotiation skills, regulatory knowledge, and collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.

26 Days AgoSaved


In-Office

Wooburn Green, Buckinghamshire, England, GBR

Software • Automation

Lead customer expansion marketing strategy and content for Bizagi’s existing customer base. Own global Sales Kick-Off strategy and delivery, partner with regional Field Marketing teams on events, centralize messaging and positioning, maintain competitive intelligence, support sales campaigns, manage budgets and vendors, and build scalable marketing programs. The role requires B2B software product marketing expertise, strong communication skills, event and budget management experience, and collaboration across UK and US teams.
